title: A Typewriter for the Compass
author: Felix Oyelaran
blurb: Mirabel Dravenmoor, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
